question: Should OpenClaw define the maximum supported inbound QQBot gateway message at 1 MiB?
rationale: The hardening mechanism is correct, but this value trades memory exposure against compatibility and delivery; current code and the inspected official QQ reference do not define a maximum legitimate event size, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent cutoff.

options.title: Approve 1 MiB
options.body: Accept the submitted tight boundary if QQBot ownership confirms every supported gateway event has adequate headroom below it.

options.title: Use Larger Headroom
options.body: Select a larger finite cap if legitimate maximum event size cannot be confidently bounded below 1 MiB.

recommendation.title: Approve 1 MiB
recommendation.body: Accept the submitted tight boundary if QQBot ownership confirms every supported gateway event has adequate headroom below it.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged Discord precedent records this person as co-author and merger on the same channel-specific WebSocket boundary decision.
